parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body of the stapler is made of steel, forming the main upper structure that holds the internal mechanism and staple magazine.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the staple pusher and spring mechanism, ensuring proper alignment and pressure during stapling.
parts.Movement_description: It moves downward when pressed to drive staples through paper and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the stapler is made of durable plastic and covers the top portion of the body, providing a comfortable surface for pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the user interface for applying pressure to activate the stapling mechanism and also protects the internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around a hinge point, moving downward when pressed and upward when released.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the stapler is made of steel and forms the bottom support structure where paper is placed for stapling.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable platform for the stapling process and contains the anvil that bends the staple legs inward or outward.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the fixed support for the stapler mechanism.
